name: Giant Owl
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Dexterity by 1. Walking speed 5 ft., fly speed 60 ft. Flight is unavailable in medium or heavy armor.
Flyby allows Disengage as a bonus action. Sight- and hearing-based Wisdom (Perception) checks have advantage. Darkvision extends to 120 ft. and shows only shades of gray in darkness.
The owl has no hands and cannot wield weapons or shields. The printed No Hands line has an apparent anatomy error about tentacles.
Talons deal 1d8 piercing as an unarmed strike. Dexterity can replace Strength for its attack and damage rolls, and the strike counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Speaks, reads, and writes Giant Owl. Understands, reads, and writes Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. Giant Owl is its only spoken language.

name: Giant Poisonous Snake
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Dexterity by 2. Walking and swim speeds 30 ft. Blindsight 10 ft.

Bite deals 1d4 piercing plus 1d4 poison as an unarmed strike. Dexterity can replace Strength for its attack and damage rolls, and the strike counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Serpentine Body prevents the snake from wearing armor, wielding weapons or shields, and using items it would have to manipulate, including spellcasting foci, wands, and tools.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common. Giant Venomous Snake is a descriptive search name for this profile.

name: Giant Spider
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Strength by 1 and Dexterity by 2. Walking and climb speeds 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Unarmored AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier.

Spider Climb covers difficult surfaces and ceilings without a check. Web Walker ignores the movement limits of webs. The spider lacks hands for weapons, shields, foci, wands, tools, and other items that require manipulation.

Bite deals 1d4 piercing plus 1d4 poison as an unarmed strike. Dexterity can replace Strength for its attack and damage rolls, and the strike counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Web is a ranged weapon attack at 30/60 ft. that restrains a creature on a hit. The creature can use its action to escape with a Strength check against 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier.
Destroying the web ends the restraint. The web has AC 10, 5 HP, resistance to bludgeoning, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The trait gives no recharge or use limit.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Giant Wasp
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
Medium Beast. Increase Dexterity by 2. Walking speed 10 ft., fly speed 50 ft. Flight is unavailable in medium or heavy armor.
The wasp has no hands for weapons, shields, foci, wands, tools, or other items that need manual manipulation.

Sting deals 1d4 piercing plus 1d4 poison as an unarmed strike. Dexterity can replace Strength for its attack and damage rolls, and the strike counts as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
